column1: # Turkish glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final.
# Term column: Turkish forms, separated by " | "; first form is the canonical one. Definitions carry D3's meanings (scratch/english-fixes/d3-*) and stay in English: they describe the en.tsv term.

# Matching: Turkish is suffixing, so a form matches at the start of a word (kilit also matches kilitli). Forms hold no apostrophe where the stem alone matches (gidon PIN matches gidon PIN’i). A form that starts with i or ı is listed in both cases, because the tools lower-case İ and I without Turkish rules.
# kilidi is deliberately not a form of lock: it appears only inside the unlock phrases.
# Rows D3 retires keep the chosen term's Turkish until their en.tsv row is dropped. D3's new rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/tr.tsv until en.tsv has their ids.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting En yüksek hız and the measured value Maksimum hız, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
